# Script to install remaining skills with delays

# Install graphic-design
echo "Installing graphic-design..."
clawhub install graphic-design --force 2>&1
sleep 30

# Install web-design
echo "Installing web-design..."
clawhub install web-design --force 2>&1
sleep 30

# Install ai-presentation-maker

sleep 30

# Install openclaw-security-scanner

c
